description: gen schema lays out each sibling `use super::{...}` import exactly as rustfmt does at the 101-column boundary: the root document declares enums whose names make the imported documents' imports 101 columns wide as one line, as one wrapped row, and as the last of two wrapped rows after a 95-column row; the 101-column line wraps into one row, and both the 101-column single row and the 101-column last row break into further rows. The three generated modules are pinned byte for byte against goldens that rustfmt leaves unchanged
